apps.description: Off-grid Android chat and gaming client for the MeshCore LoRa mesh network
apps.releaseNotes:
# Meshi v1.101

Off-grid Android chat and gaming for the MeshCore LoRa mesh network. Connects to a MeshCore node over Bluetooth LE — no internet, no cellular, no infrastructure.

## Downloads

| APK | Signing | Notes |
|-----|---------|-------|
| **app-release.apk** | Release key, R8-minified (~2.5 MB) | Recommended for general use |
| **app-debug.apk** | Debug key (~17 MB) | For troubleshooting; includes debug symbols |

> The two APKs are signed with different keys and share the same application ID. To switch between them on one device, uninstall the existing install first.

Install: enable "install from unknown sources" on your device, then open the APK.

## What's new in 1.101

This release focuses on reliability and release hardening.

### Reliability
- **Automatic send retry** with exponential backoff for transient BLE failures
- **Thread-safe** delivery-confirmation and typing-indicator tracking
- **Input validation** on all data received from the mesh (names, messages, GPS, channels) to guard against malformed packets
- **Advert expiry** — stale node advertisements time out after 30 minutes

### Architecture
- Frame-routing logic extracted into a dedicated `FrameRouter`
- Game-invite and SOS-beacon handling extracted into focused managers
- Centralised tunable constants in `MeshiConfig`

### Release hardening
- R8 code + resource shrinking for release builds (~85% smaller APK)
- On-device-only storage: cloud backup and device-to-device transfer disabled for messages, contacts, and location
- Unit test suite for game logic, input validation, and retry behaviour

## Requirements
- Android 5.0 (API 21) or newer
- A MeshCore-compatible LoRa node reachable over Bluetooth LE

## License

# Clint Browser v1.2.5

## What's New

### A Rebuilt Download Engine

Most of this update is under the hood. The download engine got a full review and a lot of fixes, so downloads should be faster, lighter, and much more reliable.

#### Auto Mode

The **Split download parts**, **Max simultaneous parts**, and **Concurrent segments** sliders now have an **Auto** option. Slide all the way to the right to use it.

With Auto, Clint picks the number of connections and adjusts it while downloading. It only adds a connection if that actually makes the download faster. It uses fewer connections on mobile data, in battery saver, or when your phone is running hot. It also remembers what worked best for each server, so the next download from that server starts at the right number.

Auto is the new default. If you already changed these sliders, your settings stay the same.

#### More Reliable

- Retries now wait longer each time instead of retrying every 5 seconds forever. The default is 10 retries, and you can still set 0 for unlimited.
- A failed attempt keeps the progress it already made instead of starting over.
- If copying a finished download to your chosen folder fails, only the copy is retried. Before, the file was deleted and downloaded again, forever.
- Downloads can continue in the background even when Android won't let Clint start a foreground service.
- Downloads paused because of no network, Wi-Fi only, or a schedule now resume correctly after a restart.
- Unfinished files now end in `.part` and get their real name once they're done.
- Leftover temporary files are cleaned up.

#### Faster and Lighter

- Downloads to a folder you chose on your device or SD card are now written straight there, instead of being downloaded first and then copied at 100%.
- Stream downloads use a lot less storage. A 4 GB video with separate audio used to need about 12 GB written. Now it's about 8 GB.
- Much fewer disk writes, which means less work for your phone during fast downloads.
- Downloads no longer compete with the rest of the app for resources.
- Fewer notification updates, so notifications don't get stuck or skipped.

#### Streams and Live Recordings

- Pausing, retrying, or restarting the app no longer deletes a live recording. It picks up where it left off.
- A live recording that keeps failing now saves what it already has instead of failing completely.
- Fixed many DASH streams that didn't download at all.
- Streams with unsupported encryption now show a clear message right away, instead of failing only after everything was downloaded.

---

### Background Playback

Background Playback is now also supported in Clint Browser. I thought this was never possible, but I saw 1DM do it, so I retraced my steps and I found how to do it. It works the same way as Background Playback on Clint Gecko, but the difference is the media information is not as detailed.

---

### Quiver Guard

I rewrote some parts of Quiver Guard to increase its adblock compatibility. Now Quiver Guard can block YouTube ads.

---

### Page Translation

You can now translate pages right inside Clint! It uses Firefox's own translation engine, so everything happens **on your device**. The page text never leaves your phone. The only thing downloaded is the language files, and they come from Mozilla.

- A translate bar slides in under the address bar. Pick the source and target languages, then tap **Translate**. Tap **Show original** to switch back.
- The bar shows up when Clint detects a page in another language, from the new **Translate page** item in the menu, or from the translate button in the address bar.
- The bar's menu has **Always translate**, **Never translate** for a language, and **Never translate this site**.
- The bar hides by itself after a few seconds. You can also swipe it up or close it.
- Clint remembers the last language you translated to.
- New **Translations** page in Settings › Browser › Tools. From there you can turn the offer and the address bar butto

# Clint Gecko v1.0.5

## What's New

### MEGA Downloads

You can now download straight from MEGA links!

- Open a MEGA file or folder link and Clint offers to download it for you.
- Folder links open a picker where you can select all, keep the folder structure, skip files you already added, and download on Wi-Fi only.
- MEGA downloads can be paused, resumed, and split into multiple parts like any other download.
- Files are decrypted on your device while they download. The key in the link never leaves your phone.
- Clint gets a fresh download link from MEGA every time a download starts or retries, so old links don't break your downloads.
- Quota limits and broken links now show a clear message instead of a vague error.
- Don't want it? Turn off **Detect MEGA links** in Settings › Downloads.

---

### Download Manager

#### Add Without Starting

New **Add** button in the bottom left of every download dialog. It puts the download in your list paused so you can start it later.

- It works for links, streams and Media Capture, blobs, MEGA files and folders, redownloads, and manual downloads.
- It skips the mobile data and battery prompts, since nothing is downloading yet.
- It's turned off while you have a scheduled start set.
- Paused blob downloads are kept safe in app storage, so they survive a restart.

(Thanks to @anonymous-shanks for suggesting this [#32](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/32))

#### Refreshing Links

- Each download now remembers the page it came from, separately from the Referer header. Refreshing a link takes you back to the right page instead of just the site's home page or the video player's site. The Properties dialog shows both.
- While you're refreshing a link, picking a video in Media Capture offers to update the paused download right away.
- Updating a link now sends the same User-Agent, Referer, and cookies as the download, skips the check when the link didn't change, ignores error pages, and tells you when a link opens a web page instead of a file.

(Thanks to @DarkHorse313 for reporting this [#16](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/16))

#### Download History

New **Save download history** and **Save Incognito download history** switches in Settings › Downloads. Turn one off and finished downloads from that mode won't stay in your Downloads list. The file and the completion notification stay either way. Unfinished, paused, and failed downloads are always kept so you can resume or retry them.

(Thanks to @anonymous-shanks for suggesting this [#32](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/32))

#### Duplicate File Handling

New **Duplicate file handling** setting in Settings › Downloads.

- **Always ask** lets you choose what to do each time.
- **Add a duplicate** keeps both files and adds a number to the new one.
- **Overwrite existing file** replaces the old file.

The automatic options only kick in when the existing download is already finished.

#### Other Download Changes

- The Downloads library remembers whether you used grid or list view.

(Thanks to @anonymous-shanks for suggesting this [#32](https://github.com/jhaiian/ClintGecko/issues/32))

---

### Faster and Smoother GeckoView

This update makes GeckoView a lot lighter on your phone, so the whole browser should feel faster.

#### Tab Switching

- Switching tabs is faster. Before, every switch made GeckoView re-save and clean up every tab running in the background. Now each background tab is only put to sleep once.
- The tab you're looking at now gets top priority, so Android is less likely to kill it when your phone is low on memory.
- Clint keeps fewer tabs active in the background on phones with less RAM. It keeps 1 on low-RAM phones, 2 under 3 GB, 4 under 5 GB, and 6 on everything else.
- Rotating the screen, folding or unfolding your phone, resizing the window, and plugging in a keyboard no longer reload all your tabs.

#### Startup and Page Loads

- Clint now loads its built-in scripts once and keeps them

## What's fixed

**A hidden number is announced as an unknown caller.** Some networks attach a placeholder name such as "Anonymous" or "Unknown" to a call from a restricted number, and the app read it out as the caller's name. A call whose number may not be shown now keeps no name: the announcement says "Unknown caller is calling" in your language, and the call screen and notification show "Unknown number".

**One call, one entry in the call log.** When an ARK call reaches the other phone but cannot connect and goes over the carrier instead, the receiving phone used to log both the ARK attempt and the carrier call, and raise a missed-call notification for a call that was still ringing. The ARK entry now waits twenty seconds and is dropped when the same caller rings over the carrier. A missed call that arrives while the app is open is marked seen rather than announced.

Update from 1.28 in place; the APK carries the same signature and your data is kept. Requires Android 8.0 or newer.

apps.description: Android app store for open-source apps on GitHub. Developers publish an app by adding the topic "arkstore" to its repository; the store installs and updates APKs straight from GitHub releases.
apps.releaseNotes:
- **Back up the installed apps**: in the settings, under App backup, the apps installed from outside Google Play are saved as their APK files, with the splits of a bundle, to a folder on the device, on a card or in a cloud service the file picker shows, or to one zip file for moving to another phone or to a service such as Google Drive. A folder stays up to date and copies only what has changed; a zip is written whole each time. The list of apps has the whole page, with a search and the choices all, none or only the apps not from Play. The store's own settings go along
- **Restore** from such a folder or zip file, on this or another device: the page tells of each app whether it is missing, behind, the same, newer, signed with another key or in need of a newer Android, and installs what is chosen one after the other. The sources, bookmarks and settings in the backup can be brought back at the same time
- **Recent backups and restores** in the settings: when, to or from where, how many apps of what size, and how each went
- **Root**: on a rooted device (Magisk, KernelSU or APatch) root can be turned on in the settings. Installs, updates, removals and restores then go through without Android asking. Root is asked for when it is first needed; if it is refused or missing, the usual prompts are used and the settings say so
- **App data in the backup**: with root on, a backup can include the apps' own data, encrypted with a password if one is given. A restore puts the data back only into the app it was taken from, signed with the same key, and only whole: every part is checked before any is put in place, and the old data is kept until all are. Without root, the apps' own data is not part of the backup, since Android does not let a store read it
- **The settings as a page of their own**, with the way back at the top, instead of a sheet pulled up over the list

Download `ARK-Store-1.9.0.apk` below and open it on your phone to install, or update from inside ARK-Store.

apps.description: Android device monitor with a home-screen widget, per-app usage insights and a charging screensaver. Fully offline - no internet permission. GPL-3.0-or-later.
apps.releaseNotes:
## What's changed

- **Quick Settings tiles**, one per figure: battery, battery temperature, processor temperature, data today, uptime, processor load, memory and storage. Add the ones you want from the panel's edit mode. A wide tile shows the figure's name and value, like Android's own tiles. A small tile shows only its icon, so it draws the figure in its place (`83%`, `35°`, `2pv`); Settings → *Quick Settings tiles* switches that off. A tile reads only while the panel is open, and a tap opens the Overview. Since Android 16, tiles added later start small: widen one in edit mode to see its name and value (#7).
- **Single figure widget.** A 1×1 home-screen widget showing the figure you pick when you add it. A long press changes the figure, and a tap opens the Overview. It follows the other widgets' black-background and opacity settings.
- **Live figures in the monitor's notification.** Off by default. Choose figures in Settings → *Notification figures* and the monitor's notification shows them on two lines among your other notifications; expand it to see them all. A swipe hides it until the screen next comes on. With none chosen it stays silent at the bottom, as before.
- **Data today** is mobile plus Wi-Fi since midnight, whatever period the data counter uses. It needs usage access, and says so without it.
- **Processor temperature** needs extended access (Shizuku or root) on most phones, the Pixels included.

More in the [FAQ](https://github.com/jrs8205/Device-Watch/blob/main/FAQ.md) and the [privacy policy](https://github.com/jrs8205/Device-Watch/blob/main/PRIVACY.md).

## Installing

Updates cleanly over v1.4.x and later. If you are coming from v1.3.1 or older (package `com.example.modernwidget`), uninstall the old app first — it is a different package and will not update.

Android-sovellus: Ilmatieteen laitoksen ja Open-Meteon sääennusteet rinnakkain, Suomen pörssisähkön hinnat ja FMI:n säävaroitukset. Nyt myös sadetutka ja sähkön keskihinnat.

## Uutta versiossa 0.5.0

- **Sadetutka.** FMI:n tutkakuvat Maanmittauslaitoksen taustakartalla: 240, 480 tai 960 km, viimeiset kolme tuntia 15 minuutin välein toistuvana animaationa, jonka nopeuden voi valita. Kartta lähennetään nipistämällä ja palautetaan kaksoisnapautuksella. Paikka on kartalla samassa kohdassa koko Suomessa, ja 960 km:n näkymä painottuu Suomen päälle.
- **Oma arvio sateesta tunniksi eteenpäin.** Uusin tutkakuva siirrettynä viime kuvista lasketun liikkeen verran. Tämä on sovelluksen oma laskelma, ei Ilmatieteen laitoksen ennuste, ja se on merkitty näkymässä selvästi.
- **Keskihinnat.** Sähkö-sivulla edellisen vuoden keskihinta ja kuluvan vuoden kuukausikeskihinnat pörssin tapaan tuntihinnoista laskettuina.
- **Huomisen hinnat vasta julkaisun jälkeen.** Halvin, kallein ja kaavio ilmestyvät vasta, kun huomisen hinnat on julkaistu. Aiemmin niissä näkyi lukuja jo ennen sitä, koska huomisen ensimmäinen tunti tiedetään päivää ennen muuta.
- **Hintakaavio.** Valitun pylvään hinta näkyy pylvään päällä ja kuluvan jakson hinta ilman napautusta.
- **Palaaminen taustalta.** Sijainti tarkistetaan aina, mutta alle 15 minuuttia vanha ennuste ja hintatieto säilyvät, ellei paikka ole vaihtunut yli kilometrin. Tuntirivit eivät enää katoa hetkeksi.
- **Käyttöliittymä.** Päivitä-nappi on poistettu: tiedot päivittyvät avauksella ja vetämällä näkymää alas. Pienet tekstit ovat hieman isompia, Varoitukset on sään vieressä alapalkissa, avoimen välilehden napautus vie sivun alkuun, sijaintipilleri vierii sisällön mukana, Sulje- ja paluunapit ovat selkeämmät ja aurinkoajoilla on otsikot.

## Asennus

- Vaatii Android 13:n tai uudemman (API 33). Kohdealusta Android 17 (API 37).
- Lataa `Saa-Sahko-0.5.0-release.apk` ja asenna. Päivitys aiemman version päälle säilyttää suosikit ja asetukset.
- APK:n SHA-256: `49E2B602139CB6C17C925F56AFFF033BD508FAD239F83AE79EB08421FFE85A8E`
- Allekirjoitusvarmenteen SHA-256: `C7:0B:B7:BE:13:92:07:37:47:8F:A8:1C:DD:82:12:BE:BE:DD:C8:AC:8B:63:26:C7:96:4B:6F:6E:B4:FF:96:5E` (julkinen varmenne liitteenä).
- Paikkahaku ja sadetutkan taustakartta vaativat oman Maanmittauslaitoksen API-avaimen käännösvaiheessa; julkaistussa APK:ssa se on mukana.

## Tietolähteet

Ilmatieteen laitos (CC BY 4.0), Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), Elering (Nord Poolin Suomen hinta-alue) ja Maanmittauslaitos (CC BY 4.0). Lisenssi Apache 2.0.
